limitations: These anonymous originals were not uploaded or copied into public source. Account state, usernames, local paths, archive contents, raw installer/proxy/process logs and full receipts are excluded.

Pack-b has 33 unflagged non-ASCII entry names decoded with CP437. Content/CRC checks match those decoded paths; intended Chinese names were not repaired or verified and no ambiguous GBK guess replaced the source archive.
Mutable options.txt/optionsof.txt and launcher metadata overrides are excluded from byte-equality counts and are reported separately.

Both import completions and recorded runtime metadata are verified. The import runner and this audit do not start either game. Later private smoke attempts are separate evidence; no title or world acceptance, or independent Java runtime version, is inferred here.
Receipt duration includes setup, hashing and cleanup; the first-to-last progress observation span is separately labelled. This is not a same-machine performance benchmark.
Original failed candidates and real network/installer failures remain historical records; these successes do not retroactively relabel them as passing.
curation: Explicit bounded whitelist only: anonymous labels, immutable input/product hashes and sizes, runtime metadata, times, aggregate independently rechecked file results and stated limitations.
